camel_example: aliyun eiam CreateApplication --region cn-hangzhou --ApplicationOwner.GroupIds.1 'example-string' --CustomFields.1.FieldName 'example-string' --ApplicationName Ram_Account_SSO --Description RAM_account_SSO_application --ApplicationTemplateId apt_ramuser_mjqrsi --ApplicationIdentityType application --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk2676xxxx --LogoUrl 'https://oss.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/logo.png' --ApplicationSourceType 'urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard' --ApplicationOwner.UserIds.1 'example-string' --CustomFields.1.FieldValue 'example-string' --SsoType saml2 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates an application resource in a specified EIAM instance
description_zh: 在指定EIAM实例下创建一个应用资源
kebab_example: aliyun eiam create-application --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk2676xxxx --application-name Ram_Account_SSO --description RAM_account_SSO_application --logo-url https://oss.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/logo.png --application-source-type urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard --sso-type saml2 --application-template-id apt_ramuser_mjqrsi --application-identity-type application --custom-fields FieldValue=example-string FieldName=example-string --application-owner '{"GroupIds":["example-string"],"UserIds":["example-string"]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplication

parameters.help_en: The URL of the application logo
parameters.name: logo_url

parameters.help_en:
The source from which the application is created. Valid values:
- urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template: application template.
- urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard: standard protocol
parameters.help_zh:
应用创建来源，取值可选范围：
- urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template：应用模板。
- urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard：标准协议
parameters.name: application_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The single sign-on protocol. Valid values:
- saml2: SAML 2.0 protocol.
- oidc: OpenID Connect protocol
parameters.help_zh:
单点登录协议，取值可选范围：
- saml2：SAML 2.0 协议。
- oidc：OpenID Connect 协议
parameters.name: sso_type

parameters.help_en: The application template ID. This parameter is required when ApplicationSourceType is set to urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template
parameters.help_zh: 应用模板ID，当ApplicationSourceType参数指定为urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template时必填
parameters.name: application_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The application identity type. Default value: application. Valid values:
- application: application.
- agent: agent
parameters.help_zh:
应用身份类型，默认为application类型，取值可选范围：
- application：应用程序。
- agent：智能体
